claim: Deep neural network pruning reduces model parameter size by 85% with less than 0.5% accuracy drop.
label: SUPPORT
evidence_text: Structured magnitude pruning eliminated 85% of non-zero weights while top-1 accuracy declined from 76.8% to 76.4%.

claim: Quantum annealing algorithms achieve exponential speedup over classical solvers for all NP-hard graph problems.
label: REFUTE
evidence_text: Polynomial speedup was observed for specific MAX-CUT instances, but exponential quantum advantage remains unproven across general NP-hard classes.

claim: Transformer attention heads exhibit 90% redundant activation patterns across all encoder layers.
label: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
evidence_text: Head importance pruning showed that 60% to 70% of attention heads in middle layers can be removed without loss.
